race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
race.verdict: FUSEBOARD won back-to-back races in the summer, the second over C&D in August in what looks strong form, and can complete a hat-trick on return from a 93-day break. Thriving 5-timer seeker Macarone looks a big threat, while Yachtsman is one of many to have slipped to a workable mark. FUSEBOARD MACARONE YACHTSMAN
race.bettingForecast: Macarone (3/1), Fuseboard (5/1), Yachtsman (13/2), Phoenix Moon (13/2), Giorgio M (7/1), Midnight Call (12/1), Koffee And Kale (14/1), Far Too Fizzy (14/1), An Outlaw's Grace (14/1), Herculeus (16/1), Elvetham (16/1), Way To Dubai (20/1)
